full_judgment: 4. The defendant-petitioner contested the suit by filing written statement contending, inter alia, that the plaintiff has no title and possession in the suit premises and the defendant petitioner is not a monthly tenant under him and no relationship of landlord and tenant does exist between the defendant and the plaintiff. It was stated by the defendant that under the Thakur Proshad Tewary Estate there were certain vacant land in Comilla town recorded in Khas khatian No. 1 in the name of the Estate owned and possessed by Rani Ragu Bangsha Dulari in Taluki right. Buildings were constructed and structures were raised by different persons on the said land with the permission of the landlord to carry on business as monthly tenants under the said Estate and the defendant-petitioner paid monthly rents in the Comilla Thakur Proshad Tewary Estate obtaining rent receipts. One Baikunta Chandra Paul, the predecessor-in-interest of the defendant-petitioner made constructions on the lands and started business therein under the name and style "Bibekananda Store" since 1332 BS. Baikunta Chandra Paul died in 1359 leaving Arjun Chandra Paul and Narendra Chandra Paul as his brother's son. Thereafter defendant-petitioner by way of inheritance from Arjun Chandra Paul and by way of purchase of the share of Narendra Chandra Paul has been carrying on business in the premises. It was also stated that the alleged power of attorney is forged and for that matter the subsequent transfers of the shops of the suit premises in the name of Shafiqur Rahman and thereafter in the name of the plaintiffs are all sham transactions. It was alleged that Abdus Sabur Khan, a Tahshildar of the enemy property office by exerting his influence created forged Power of Attorney in the name of Rani Ragu Bangsha Dulari in favour of Abdul Khaleque, a fictitious name, and created a sale deed in the name of his brother Shafiqur Rahman and other relations and then transferred the property to the plaintiffs and others. The Government having come to know about these underhand deals started criminal cases against Abdus Sabur Khan and Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) and others and those cases are pending for disposal. The Government having acquired the estate of Rani Ragu Bangsha Dulari has virtually become the owner of the premises but has not been realising rent because of the said anti-corruption cases. The defendant instituted inter pleader suit No. 325 of 1986 for determination as to who is the real owner and the Government also contested the suit but the said was unfortunately dismissed on 15.11.88.
